artworks.title: Officer, Front View
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of a person with curly hair under a hat adorned with feathers. The person is standing with a confident posture in both illustrations, with one hand resting on their hip and the other inside a pocket or at the front. They have a serious expression on their face with prominent facial features. The outfit consists of a knee-length coat with decorative embroidery along the edges, a shirt underneath, and matching pants that tuck into tall boots. A belt is worn around the waist, accessorized with a sheathed sword hanging by the side. The background is plain with no visible objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Man in Cloak, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures walking forward. Both have curly hair under wide-brimmed feathered hats and wear long draped garments that reach their calves. Underneath, they wear knee-length clothing and pointy shoes. The figures are seen from the back, with their faces hidden, on a textured parchment-like background with no other details or scenery.

artworks.title: Officer with Large Plume, Front View
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in elaborate clothing with hats and raised arms. It features two similarly dressed figures standing side by side, each wearing voluminous attire with flowing drapery and detailed textures. Their outfits include knee-length pants and billowing shirts, topped with large hats adorned with feathers. The figures pose with one arm raised. Shadows and cross-hatching provide depth and form to the figures, while their expressions and stance suggest a sense of merriment. The style reflects attention to fabric folds and human posture.

artworks.title: Officer with Feathers in Cap, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body illustrations of identical figures, portrayed from a rear view. Both figures are standing with their left arms bent and resting on their hips, while their right arms are extended, pointing to the right side of the image. The figures have curly hair visible from the back and wear hats with feathers. They are dressed in long jackets with detailed buttons running down the back, along with knee-high textured boots. Each figure appears to have a sword hanging by their side. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with no discernible features or objects.

artworks.title: Officer with Plume, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image displays two figures standing side by side with their backs to the viewer. Both are extending their right arms outward. They have curly hair and wear hats with feathers. Their knee-length garments have striped patterns, puffed sleeves, and tight leggings. One figure has one shoe, while the other wears soft-heeled shoes. There is no visible jewelry, and neither figure is holding any objects. In the background, there are more similarly dressed figures walking away with long poles. The setting is outdoors with distant landscape elements like a small bush on the left.

artworks.title: Two Turks
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing side by side. Each person wears a turban with a feather, has a beard and mustache, and is dressed in a robe with wide sleeves. The robes have vertical lines. The figures wear simple shoes and the person on the left appears to be holding gloves. In the background, there are smaller figures in similar attire on a plain, flat surface.

artworks.title: The Young Jesus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8 × 6 cm (3 1/8 × 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, with one foot stepping on a creature resembling a dragon. The person is positioned leaning on a table covered with a decorative cloth, with their head turned towards the right. Their facial features include youthful attributes with curly hair. The figure wears a long robe that extends to the ankles and holds a staff with a cross on the top in their right hand. They have a halo around their head. Beside the person on the table is a globe-like object with a plant on top. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 × 3.9 cm (2 1/16 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures seated around a table. The central figure emits light, while the other two figures are also shown. One figure on the left appears to be pouring from a jug. The table has plates on it. The figures are dressed in flowing garments, and the background is simple.

artworks.title: The Marriage at Cana
artworks.dimensions: plate (trimmed within plate mark): 4.6 × 4 cm (1 13/16 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a table set with food. The drawing depicts several figures seated around a circular table covered with a tablecloth. The table is adorned with various dishes and utensils. One figure stands near the table, possibly serving or presenting a dish, while another figure in the background holds a container. The scene conveys a sense of gathering and hospitality, highlighted by the interplay of lines and a sunburst pattern radiating from one central figure, creating a focal point. The setting appears intimate, inviting the observer into a moment of shared experience.

artworks.title: The Feast of the Pharisees
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.5 × 3.9 cm (1 3/4 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows seven individuals seated around a circular table set with various dishes. Most figures are visible from the waist up, with one person fully prostrate at the feet of another. Two figures have halos around their heads, with one emitting rays. The individuals have detailed facial features and various hairstyles, wearing long flowing robes. The prostrate figure seems to lean on the one with the halo. The table is filled with plates of food, and a seated figure holds a chalice. The background is plain, emphasizing the group at the table.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5.8 × 4 cm (2 5/16 × 1 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a table. Several figures are seated around a circular table, with one central figure emitting radiant light depicted with lines extending outward. The figures are arranged closely around the table, which is adorned with various items. The scene is rendered in a monochrome palette, using fine lines to convey detail and texture. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques add depth to the composition, enhancing the intricacy of robes and facial expressions.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 12.5 × 30 cm (4 15/16 × 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a riverside event, possibly a festival. An ornate frame surrounds groups of people near the river, depicted in intricate detail. The background features a bustling crowd along the riverbanks and old-world architecture in the distance. The sky is detailed with fine line work. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of an etching.

artworks.title: The Holy Trinity in the Tree of Life, Adored by Franciscans
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 19.9 × 19.3 cm (7 13/16 × 7 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large tree with spreading branches. Above the tree are two figures on clouds. Between them is a bird surrounded by symbols. Below the tree, a group of robed figures is gathered reverently. In the background, a distant building is visible. The drawing shows detailed shading and intricate line work.

artworks.title: La belle jardinière
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.2 × 12.3 cm (7 3/16 × 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental banner with Classical figures. The central focus is a hanging banner adorned with intricate text that appears to be an inscription, surrounded by decorative foliage and garlands. Above the banner is a coat of arms or heraldic emblem. Flanking the banner are two seated figures, both dressed in traditional robes; one holds a laurel wreath and a musical instrument, the other holds a tray of fruit. The composition features detailed line work and balance.

artworks.title: Giovanni Domenico Peri
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.1 × 15 cm (7 15/16 × 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a circular portrait of a man with a bald head, short hair on the sides, and a pointed beard. The man is facing slightly to the right, with a calm expression. He wears patterned clothing with a high collar. Around the portrait is an ornate frame with design elements. Two oxen flank the portrait. Various objects like a violin, a cart wheel, a plow, and straw forks are placed around the frame. Laurel branches form an arch above the portrait. The artwork combines elements of agriculture, music, and craftsmanship in an etching or engraving style background.

artworks.title: The Stag Hunt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.2 x 45.7 cm (7 9/16 x 18 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a panoramic scene of a hunting activity in a forest. Tall trees line the sides, with leaves reaching towards the center where the hunt takes place. The background shows treetops and a distant cliff, adding depth. The scene is detailed, showing hunters and hounds in action, with intricate brushwork providing texture and movement. The color scheme is mainly browns and beiges, giving an old-fashioned look. Activity in the foreground contrasts with the serene landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: The Stag Hunt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.2 × 48 cm (7 15/16 × 18 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a hunting scene with hunters on horseback and on foot guiding packs of dogs in a wooded area. The scene includes trees, a river, and a castle-like structure in the distance. The detailed engravings focus on the dynamic movement of the figures and animals. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadows.

artworks.title: Pride (Vanity)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 5.2 cm (2 5/8 × 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in an elaborate pose, wearing historical fashion. They hold a mirror and an indistinct object, standing next to a detailed peacock with its tail fanned out. A small winged creature interacts with the scene above. The background is plain with a light, neutral tone. The word "Superbia" is written beneath the illustration.

artworks.title: Sloth
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.9 × 5.2 cm (2 11/16 × 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a figure sitting on a donkey. Two small winged creatures are seen flying above. The word "Pigrizia" is inscribed below. The illustration conveys a sense of inactivity and whimsy with a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Gluttony
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7 × 5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing titled "Gula". The image depicts a figure draped in flowing garments, holding a goblet high in one hand, and a basket in the other. Atop the figure's head is a fantastical creature with wings. Beside the figure, a boar is depicted, feasting on items on the ground. The drawing suggests themes of indulgence and consumption, often associated with the sin of gluttony. The composition is intricate, with detailed line work providing texture and form to the garments, the boar, and the mythical creature.

artworks.title: Lust
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7 × 5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure draped in a cloth with one arm extended. The person is in a frontal position with their head turned slightly to the left. The figure has delicate facial features, an upturned hairstyle with ornamental details, an intricate hairstyle, and is wearing a necklace. They are partially covered by a fabric draped around the shoulders and lower body. A bird is perched on the outstretched hand, and a small winged creature is flying nearby. A goat stands beside the figure. The background is blank with the text "Luxuria" below the figure.

artworks.title: Envy
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7 × 5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure of a mythical creature. The creature appears humanoid with lean limbs and a tangle of snake-like appendages as hair. Its mouth is partly open, with one hand gripping a serpentine figure that extends outward. Draped around its body is a torn fabric that billows as if blown by the wind. Accompanying the creature is a small dog-like animal with an elongated body and fierce expression. The scene conveys a sense of motion and narrative. The word "Invidia" is inscribed below.

artworks.title: Anger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.2 × 5.5 cm (2 7/16 × 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing features an allegorical figure representing rage in dynamic motion. The figure holds a sword aloft with one hand and a shield with the other. Flowing garments suggest movement, while the stylized features emphasize a fierce expression. Next to the figure lies a lion, representing courage or ferocity. Above the figure, a small creature with wings enhances the theme of chaotic energy. The drawing is done in a detailed, classical style indicative of either etching or engraving techniques from a historical period.

artworks.title: Greed
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 7 × 5.2 cm (2 3/4 × 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of an individual standing upright. The person has an elongated facial structure with a beard and wears a hooded garment. Their hair is not visible due to the hood. The clothing consists of a long robe with draped sleeves and a visible robe underneath. The individual is clutching onto a bundle or bag with both hands, and a small box or bag sits in front of them on the ground next to a larger sack. A formation atop their head resembles horns or twisting branches. The background is plain, with no distinct features. The word "Auaritia" is inscribed at the bottom.
